d:
Enjoy this masterful live recording of "The Valley Recalls", captured at Mumbai's Nehru Centre in December 1995, featuring an extraordinary ensemble of legendary Indian musicians.
This concert brings together Pandits Shivkumar Sharma (Santoor), Hariprasad Chaurasia (Bansuri), Bhavani Shankar (Pakhawaj), Anindo Chatterjee (Tabla), and Shubhankar Banerjee (Tabla).
"The Valley Recalls" is one of the best-selling titles with Volume 1 showcasing tracks like "Peace, Love, and Harmony" and Volume 2 featuring the mesmerizing Raga Bhoopali.
